resources.string: Supervised URL demo

This demo uses an Accessibility Service only to display a small floating pointer and Pause, Resume, and Stop controls above other apps. It does not read screen content, perform gestures, or automate sensitive actions. Open demo only asks your browser to open the fixed public URL below; the browser may use your existing signed-in session. No browsing results are read. The local audit contains session actions only and is not transmitted. Optional AI requests send only your typed task to the selected HTTPS bridge or local OmniRoute and its AI providers. Local OmniRoute uses HTTP only on this tablet at localhost:20128. Each proposed action needs a separate approval. Connection settings, task text and tokens are saved encrypted using Android Keystore. Saved tokens are used without displaying them; use Forget saved connection and token to remove them. In local mode use an OmniRoute inference token; in bridge mode use its separate bridge token.\n\nFirst acknowledge this disclosure, then enable Supervised URL demo in Android Accessibility settings. Return here and tap Arm for each new session. Enabling the service never arms it automatically. Stop removes the overlay and clears the armed session; you can disable the service in Settings at any time.
Displays supervised demo controls only. No screen reading or gestures. Enable here, then return to the app and explicitly Arm. Stop removes all overlay controls.
